name: Aurochs
publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse
printing: First printing, October 2021. The title released in 2022.
sourceAccess: Official index confirms the entry. The publisher creature link redirects to the marketplace without entitlement. Rules verified against the printed folio in the local .
errataEvidence: Wizards’ Sage Advice & Errata index lists no dedicated Monsters of the Multiverse correction sheet. No official correction to this entry was located.
operationalEvidence: Left column of p. 71 gives the Gore attack and its immediate straight-run condition. The extra damage is applied to the target. A creature can also fall prone on a failed Strength save.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description based on anatomy in the printed entry or its illustration and checked against the selected portrait.
habitatEvidence: Terrain tags from the Appendix Monster Lists, printed p. 287.
